Tour_QuestionTitle: What do you mostly use the deck for?
Tour_LookingHint: Next I show a draft on your deck. It is only a preview: the keys run nothing and your own profile stays as it is.
Tour_ComposeTitle: Your draft is on the deck

Tour_FocusSmartHomeDesc: Lights and switches in Home Assistant.

Assist_OfferText: MasterHub can make profiles for programs it finds on this PC (for example OBS or Discord). They stay switched off until you switch them on. It can also suggest a profile for a program you use a lot.
Assist_OfferPrivacy: To know which programs you use, it counts how long each program is in front. The numbers stay on this PC. You can turn all of it off in Settings.
Assist_NudgeApp: You use {0} a lot, but it has no profile yet. Want to look at a sketch for it?
Assist_NudgeModule: A new part was connected for the first time: {0}. Want to look at a sketch for it?
Assist_NudgeUnused: Key {0} ("{1}") has not been pressed in a long time. Want to change it?
Assist_SettingsDesc: Prepares profiles for the programs on this PC and makes small suggestions. Nothing changes by itself: prepared profiles stay switched off and a suggestion only opens a preview.
Assist_MasterDesc: Counts how long each program is in front (on this PC only), prepares switched-off profiles for the programs it finds and suggests a profile for programs you use a lot. One switch turns all of it off.
Assist_PressDesc: Counts how often each key is pressed, so it can point out a key that is never used. Off by default; the numbers stay on this PC.
Profiles_ReadyHint: Not linked yet: it switches in with {0} once you switch it on.

Update_EnableDesc: At start and every 6 hours. Off by default; nothing is sent while it is off.
Update_NotConfigured: Enter the GitHub repository (owner/name) to check.
